dct_description_sm:
The file includes complete election results by voting location, all candidate names and total votes. Also included are the results from one vote anywhere fully accessible voting location and the advance voting locations. Acclamations are also shown. Voting locations change between elections and cannot be compared.

There are many locations inside a ward and the electors that live or own property in that ward are free to vote at any location within the same ward.

There was a change in the name of the French Public School board from Consel scolaire de district du Centre-Sud-Ouest to Conseil Scolaire Viamonde.

Note: To avoid Microsoft Excel from auto-formatting some fields, open CSV file in notepad for best results.
